text: Festivals connect people to their history in a way that textbooks can't. When children help to cook a traditional dish or learn an old game, they absorb the culture naturally, without feeling that they're being taught. Festivals also bring together people who might not meet otherwise, such as neighbours or distant relatives, so they strengthen communities as well as traditions.

tips.en: In a way that textbooks can't makes a strong start.
tips.kk: In a way that textbooks can't — күшті басталу.
tips.ru: In a way that textbooks can't — сильное начало.
tips.example: in a way that textbooks can't

tips.en: Strengthen communities as well as traditions concludes with two benefits.
tips.kk: Strengthen communities as well as traditions — екі пайда туралы қорытынды.
tips.ru: Strengthen communities as well as traditions — вывод о двух пользах.

questions.followUp: What would be lost without them?
questions.question: Why is it important for a country to keep its traditional festivals?

text: Some of them have, definitely. New Year in particular has turned into a shopping season, with advertising starting in November and people feeling pressure to buy expensive presents. I think the meaning of a holiday gets lost when it's mainly about spending. Traditional festivals like Nauryz are still less commercial, but I can see shops starting to sell special decorations for it too.

tips.en: New Year in particular … supports the position with an example.
tips.kk: New Year in particular … — ұстаным мысалмен бекітілген.
tips.ru: New Year in particular … — позиция подкреплена примером.
tips.example: New Year in particular has turned into a shopping season

tips.en: I can see shops starting to … looks ahead.
tips.kk: I can see shops starting to … — жауап алға қарайды.
tips.ru: I can see shops starting to … — ответ смотрит вперёд.
tips.example: I can see shops starting to sell special decorations

text: I think the current number is about right. More holidays would give people more rest and time with family, which is good for health. On the other hand, businesses lose money when everything closes, and long breaks in winter or spring can slow down work and school. Rather than adding holidays, it might be better to give employees more flexible leave they can take whenever they need it.

tips.en: The current number is about right states a clear point of view.

tips.ru: The current number is about right — ясная точка зрения.
tips.example: the current number is about right

tips.kk: Rather than adding holidays … — жауап басқа жол ұсынады.
tips.ru: Rather than adding holidays … — ответ предлагает другой путь.

note.en: “Time off that can be taken at any time”.

questions.followUp: What would be the effect on the economy?
questions.question: Should a country have more public holidays?

text: Mostly, yes, as long as they don't replace local traditions. Halloween and Valentine's Day have become popular among young people here, mainly through films and social media. They're fun and harmless, and they show that cultures are becoming more connected. The only concern is when shops promote foreign holidays much more than local ones, because that can make young people forget their own.

tips.en: As long as they don't replace local traditions is a yes with a condition.
tips.kk: As long as they don't replace local traditions — ескертпесі бар «иә».
tips.ru: As long as they don't replace local traditions — «да» с оговоркой.

questions.followUp: Which foreign festivals are popular in your country?
questions.question: Is it a good thing when people celebrate festivals from other countries?

text: In some ways, yes — they're less interested in the formal side, like long speeches at family gatherings. But they often enjoy the parts they can share, such as concerts, games or cooking with friends, and they post a lot about them online. So I'd say they celebrate differently rather than less. Their parents probably said the same thing about them at their age.

tips.en: The formal side … But … the parts they can share is a precise analysis.
tips.kk: The formal side … But … the parts they can share — дәл талдау.
